name: FunSpot 1713
description: Just 3 miles from the heart of Gulf Shores alongside Lagoon Pass, this Gulf-front Fun Spot is beckoning large families and groups of up to 15 to sit back, relax, and enjoy the beach. With two spacious living areas, a fully-stocked kitchen, five tranquil bedrooms, multiple Gulf-view decks, and direct beach access, Fun Spot is paradise found.
